title: Noisy-Label Calibration with Multiple Unreliable Labels
abstract: arXiv:2610.19543v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In medical annotation and crowdsourcing, multiple annotators assign labels to each example, but these labels may be incorrect. Treating such noisy labels as ground truth can bias calibration evaluation. To address this problem, we propose methods for evaluating and recalibrating a fixed binary predictor under the underlying clean-label distribution, using only noisy annotations. First, given annotator-specific noise probabilities, we propose Noise Corrected ECE (NC-ECE), a binned estimator of expected calibration error (ECE) under class-conditional noise. We derive non-asymptotic bounds on the estimator's bias. Then, we propose practical algorithms for estimating unknown noise probabilities under conditional independence and label-orientation assumptions. translated_title: 基于多个不可靠标签的噪声标签校准
translated_abstract: 在医学标注和众包场景中，多个标注者会为每个样本分配标签，但这些标签可能是错误的。将此类噪声标签视为真实标签会使校准评估产生偏差。为解决这一问题，我们提出了在潜在干净标签分布下，仅利用噪声标注来评估和重新校准固定二元预测器的方法。首先，在给定各标注者噪声概率的条件下，我们提出了噪声校正ECE（NC-ECE），即类条件噪声下期望校准误差（ECE）的分箱估计器，并推导了该估计器偏差的非渐近界。随后，我们在条件独立性和标签方向性假设下，提出了估计未知噪声概率的实用算法。我们还开发了基于损失和基于直方图的事后重校准方法，分别具有干净风险保证和校准保证。在半合成基准上的实验表明，所提出的方法……
tldr: 该论文提出了噪声校正ECE（NC-ECE）估计器、噪声概率估计算法以及事后重校准方法，使得在仅有多个不可靠标注的情况下，也能对二元分类器的校准性能进行无偏评估和可靠重校准。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Noise Corrected ECE (NC-ECE), noise probability estimation algorithms, and post-hoc recalibration methods, enabling unbiased evaluation and reliable recalibration of binary classifiers using only multiple unreliable annotations.
